# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
from brackets import balanced

bs = '\\'

cases = [
    ('', True),
    ('()', True),
    ('([{}])', True),
    ('(', False),
    (')', False),
    ('(]', False),
    ('([)]', False),
    ('a(b)c[d]{e}', True),
    ('"("', True),
    ('"(" )', False),
    ('"(" (', False),
    ('"', False),
    ('"a' + bs, False),
    ('"a' + bs + '"' + '"', True),
    ('"' + bs + bs + '"', True),
    ('"' + bs + '"' + ')', False),
    ("'('", False),
    ('{"a": [1, 2]}', True),
    ('"[" [', False),
]

for text, expected in cases:
    got = balanced(text)
    assert got == expected, (text, got, expected)
print('ok')
